title: Receipt - a completed and signed form (Section 9)

binding.description: Hash of the binding of its own block (Section 8, rule 3).

created_at.description: The agent's clock, an UNTRUSTED value. Only the bounds in Section 11 carry evidentiary weight.

payload.description: type is an extension point and is not interpreted by the core. The content NEED NOT be disclosed: a hash may stand in for the body.

provenance.description: Provenance chain (Section 9.1). The model is not "the hash survives transformation" but "every transformation yields a new verifiable heir". It matches ingredient/parentOf in C2PA.

parents.description: An array by construction: merging several sources into one result is ordinary, not exceptional.

receipt.description: The hash of the parent receipt, not a copy of it: embedding the full parent grows the chain size linearly with its length.

source_content_hash.description: Which version of the source was actually used: the parent receipt may describe a different file than the one fed as input.

authorization.description: OPAQUE to the core: ref is a hash, action is a string. The rights model lies outside the core (Section 17) - the presence and integrity of the reference are checked, but not its meaning.
